steps.title: Ihram
steps.subtitle: Enter the state of consecration
steps.description: The first step of Hajj is to enter the state of Ihram before crossing the Miqat.

preparation: Trim nails and remove unwanted hair
Wear Ihram garments (2 white unstitched cloths for men, modest dress for women)

duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayka Laa Shareeka Laka Labbayk
duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am.

restrictions: Men: No covered headwear, no stitched garments
tips: Wear comfortable footwear (sandals that don't cover ankle)
Keep important documents in a money belt
Carry a small bag for essentials

steps.title: Arrival in Makkah
steps.subtitle: Enter the sacred city
steps.description: Arrive in Makkah with humility and devotion.

procedure: Enter Masjid al-Haram with right foot
First sight of the Kaaba - make heartfelt dua
Proceed to perform Tawaf al-Qudum (arrival Tawaf)

duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

tips: Take care of elderly and children
Note your hotel location and landmarks

steps.title: Tawaf
steps.subtitle: Circumambulate the Kaaba
steps.description: Circle the Kaaba seven times counterclockwise.

procedure: Start at the Black Stone - point and say "Bismillahi Allahu Akbar"
Walk counterclockwise keeping Kaaba on your left
Touch/kiss Black Stone if possible; otherwise point to it
Walk at normal pace, men jog first 3 rounds (Raml)
Touch Yemeni corner if possible without causing harm
Recite duas between Yemeni corner and Black Stone

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan waqina adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

tips: Don't harm others to reach the Black Stone
If you lose count, assume the lower number
Wheelchair users can perform Tawaf on upper levels

steps.title: Sa'i
steps.subtitle: Walk between Safa and Marwah
steps.description: Walk seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah.

preparation: After Tawaf and prayer at Maqam Ibrahim
Face the Kaaba and make dua
procedure: Start at Safa - recite: "Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah"
Reach Marwah, face Kaaba, make dua

duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ
duas.translation: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

steps.title: Day of Tarwiyah (8th Dhul Hijjah)
steps.subtitle: Depart to Mina
steps.description: Spend the day and night in Mina in worship.

procedure: Pray Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and next Fajr in Mina
Engage in worship, dhikr, and dua

duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being.

steps.title: Day of Arafah (9th Dhul Hijjah)
steps.subtitle: Stand at Mount Arafat
steps.description: The most important day of Hajj - standing at Arafat.

procedure: Pray Dhuhr and Asr combined and shortened at Dhuhr time
Stand anywhere in Arafat (not necessary to climb the mount)
Engage in dua, dhikr, and worship until sunset
Make dua for yourself, family, and all Muslims

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over everything.

tips: THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT DAY

steps.title: Muzdalifah
steps.subtitle: Night under the open sky
steps.description: Proceed to Muzdalifah after sunset and spend the night there.

preparation: Do NOT pray Maghrib at Arafat
procedure: Pray Maghrib (3) and Isha (2) combined at Isha time
Collect 49-70 pebbles for stoning (size of chickpeas)
Sleep under open sky if possible
Women, elderly, and weak may leave after midnight
Others leave after Fajr before sunrise

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.

tips: Pebbles don't need to be from Muzdalifah
Marble or stone can be used

steps.title: Rami (Stoning) - Day 1
steps.subtitle: Stone the largest pillar
steps.description: Return to Mina and stone Jamarat al-Aqabah.

preparation: Can be done between Fajr and sunset
procedure: Stone only the large pillar (Jamarat al-Aqabah)
Stop reciting Talbiyah after first stone
tips: Don't need to hit the pillar exactly
Stone must land in the pit

steps.title: Sacrifice (Qurbani)
steps.subtitle: Offer animal sacrifice
steps.description: Offer sacrifice on Eid day (10th Dhul Hijjah).

preparation: Arrange for sacrifice (sheep, goat, cow, or camel)
Can be done through voucher system
procedure: If using voucher, sacrifice done on your behalf

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi wallahu Akbar, Allahumma minka wa lak
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, from You and for You.

tips: Voucher system is convenient and trusted
Must be done before sunset on 13th

steps.title: Halq or Taqsir
steps.subtitle: Cut or shave hair
steps.description: Men shave or trim hair, women trim fingertip length.

procedure: Men: Complete shaving (Halq) is better, or trim (Taqsir)
Women: Trim fingertip length from each section
This releases you from most Ihram restrictions
Perfume and normal clothes now allowed
Marital relations still prohibited until Tawaf al-Ifadah

duas.translation: O Allah, forgive those who shave.

tips: Keep some hair as memory if desired

steps.title: Tawaf al-Ifadah
steps.subtitle: The main Tawaf of Hajj
steps.description: Perform Tawaf and Sa'i (if not done earlier).

procedure: Perform Sa'i if not done after Tawaf al-Qudum

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan waqina adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter.

tips: Can go any time during these days

steps.title: Days of Tashriq (11-13 Dhul Hijjah)
steps.subtitle: Stone all three pillars
steps.description: Spend nights in Mina and stone all three Jamarat.

preparation: Have 21 pebbles ready (7 for each Jamrah)
procedure: Stone all three Jamarat in order after Zawal:
1. Small pillar (Jamarat al-Ula) - 7 pebbles, then make dua
2. Middle pillar (Jamarat al-Wusta) - 7 pebbles, then make dua
3. Large pillar (Jamarat al-Aqabah) - 7 pebbles, no dua after
If staying 13th, must stone on 13th too
Must leave Mina before sunset on 12th to skip 13th
tips: Can stone until Fajr next day
Take turns in group for convenience

steps.title: Tawaf al-Wida (Farewell Tawaf)
steps.subtitle: Bid farewell to the Kaaba
steps.description: The last rite of Hajj before leaving Makkah.

preparation: Done after all Hajj rites complete
Should be last thing before leaving Makkah
procedure: Ask Allah to return you to His House

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي وَارْزُقْنِي الْعَوْدَ إِلَى بَيْتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal minni warzuqni al-awda ila baytik
duas.translation: O Allah, accept from me and grant me a return to Your House.

tips: Don't engage in trade after this
Can get supplies but don't delay extensively
